en: One of his aides is waiting for you in the building on Route 2. He has something for you, once you've caught a few Pokémon.

en: Tickets for the Sevii ferry! Every seat counted, every stub torn. That's my job.
Seat thirteen, the ghost's seat? Paid for every sailing, empty every sailing. I found this stub under it last night.
Look at the tear, though. I tear every stub on the left. This one's torn on the right. It isn't one of mine.
{player} noted the ticket stub torn by someone else's hand.
Torn on the right. Whoever sold that ticket, it wasn't this office.
No more ghost on the ferry. Seat thirteen has a real passenger now, with a real ticket. One of mine!
I fish off this quay every evening. The ferry comes and goes, and the fish don't mind it a bit.
The ferry? Funny thing. Every evening, after the crew have counted heads, Dov the dockhand waves one more traveller aboard.
Not up the gangway, mind. Up the cargo ramp, with the crates. And he pockets something as they pass.
{player} noted the fisherman's remark about the cargo ramp.
One more up the cargo ramp, after the count. Every evening, regular as the tide.
Dov's on the gangway now, checking tickets like a proper sailor. The fish miss him, I expect.
Dov
Looker's friend, eh? So somebody found my stub. Thought a ghost story would keep folk from asking.
Fine. If I'm to be caught, I'll be caught fighting. Right here on the quay!
...Sunk. All right. I'll pay back every fare I took twice. Tell Looker I'll be at his door, ghost and all.
Lockwork moves its cargo quietly. You've seen too much of it already.
That one's heart is locked tight. It'll fight for me without a second thought.
Tch. Doesn't matter. The cargo's already on its way.
Keep walking. Lockwork doesn't forget a face.
You're on the dock without a docket. Lockwork doesn't like that.
My partner here was locked at the works. It obeys. That's all it needs to do.
You knocked the numbers right out of my ledger.
I'm counting crates. Count yourself out of here.
Nobody asked you to look in the crates.
A locked heart never hesitates. Let me show you.
So hesitation isn't everything after all.
Go on. The admin will be the one to deal with you.
This stretch of the harbour is Lockwork's for the evening.
We seal their hearts so nothing ever comes between us. Efficient, isn't it?
Efficient. And beaten. Wonderful.
Lockwork pays well. I'd still rather not face you twice.
Down there's the admin's office. Go on, then. You'll come back up quicker than you went in.
